description:
pkix-ct/src/log_list.rs:10-14: 'pkix-ct ships no built-in log list. Consumers populate the list from a source they trust.' This matches the workspace-wide stance in AGENTS.md: 'no baked-in trust data, no baked-in trust source.'

A future contributor might suggest 'ship a compiled-in Mozilla CCADB CT log list / Chrome list / Apple list for convenience.' Workspace policy is explicit that this is rejected — trust data is deployment configuration, not library content. pkix-ct enforces it via API: the only ways to populate CtLogList are caller-supplied DER bytes or caller-supplied JSON from a source they trust.

The Google log_list.json parser is opt-in via the log-list-json feature flag. Even with the parser enabled, no JSON is bundled — the caller must read it from somewhere they trust. This matches pkix-truststore's 'no baked-in roots' stance.

Defend this: refuse to ship a CCADB-bundled or Chrome-bundled log list, no matter how convenient it seems for getting-started examples.
